modules.title: Introduction to Democracy and the Rule of Law
modules.html:
Features and types of democracy, and the principles of the rule of law. This section covers introduction to democracy and the rule of law.

Key points

  • The three pillars of the Rule of Law according to A.V. Dicey include the following EXCEPT _____. — Right to bear arms.
  • The rule of law ensures that every citizen has a 'Right to Fair Hearing', which means _____. — The person must be heard before a competent court before judgment.
  • The concept of 'Rule of Law' implies that _____. — Law is supreme over everyone.
  • Who popularized the principle of the Rule of Law — A.V. Dicey.
  • Rule of Law: — Supremacy of law.

Worked examples

Q: The three pillars of the Rule of Law according to A.V. Dicey include the following EXCEPT _____.
A: Right to bear arms — Dicey's three pillars are Supremacy of the law, Equality before the law, and the Constitution as a result of the ordinary law of the land (protection of rights).

Q: The rule of law ensures that every citizen has a 'Right to Fair Hearing', which means _____.
A: The person must be heard before a competent court before judgment — Fair hearing is a fundamental right ensuring that a person is given the opportunity to present their case before an impartial court.

The rule of law ensures that every citizen has a 'Right to Fair Hearing', which means _____.
examples.a: The person must be heard before a competent court before judgment

quiz.q: The three pillars of the Rule of Law according to A.V. Dicey include the following EXCEPT _____.
quiz.solution: Dicey's three pillars are Supremacy of the law, Equality before the law, and the Constitution as a result of the ordinary law of the land (protection of rights).

quiz.q: The rule of law ensures that every citizen has a 'Right to Fair Hearing', which means _____.
options: The judge must be the person's friend
The person must be heard before a competent court before judgment
Wealthy people can buy the judge
quiz.solution: Fair hearing is a fundamental right ensuring that a person is given the opportunity to present their case before an impartial court.

quiz.q: The concept of 'Rule of Law' implies that _____.
options: The President is above the law
Judges can do whatever they like
quiz.solution: Rule of Law means that the law is the highest authority and is applicable to both the rulers and the ruled equally.

quiz.q: Who popularized the principle of the Rule of Law?
quiz.solution: Albert Venn Dicey, a British jurist, outlined the three pillars of the rule of law: Supremacy of law, Equality before the law, and Fundamental Human Rights.

quiz.q: The Rule of Law ensures:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Supremacy of the law.

quiz.q: A major pillar of democracy is _____.
quiz.solution: An independent judiciary ensures that democratic processes are followed and that the rights of citizens are protected from executive overreach.

quiz.q: Democracy is often defined as _____.
options: Government of the people, by the people, and for the people
quiz.solution: This famous definition by Abraham Lincoln highlights that the power in a democracy belongs to the citizens.

quiz.q: The supreme law of Nigeria is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria is the highest law; any other law that contradicts it is null and void.

quiz.q: Capitalist democracy emphasizes:
